step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identified external entry point (ThirdParty cloud event streams) sending real-time security events into the 'COLLECT' Kinesis Data Streams.
2. Ingestion flow moves data from 'COLLECT' Kinesis Data Streams into Amazon Neptune (primary graph storage for 50M+ resources) and forwards events to 'RULES' Kinesis Data Streams.
3. Data from Neptune fans out into OpenSearch (Elasticsearch) and DynamoDB for search, reporting, and backing store requirements.
4. Neptune and OpenSearch feed metrics into CloudWatch, which informs the SHARD controller loop back to Kinesis Data Streams for load distribution.
5. 'RULES' Kinesis Data Streams evaluates security rules against Neptune graph state, persisting violation results into DynamoDB.
6. DynamoDB triggers notifications sent to external ThirdParty integrations (Slack, Email, Splunk).
